verdict.rationale: Docs reference both a global install and a 'vendored' (project-local) install mode, with automatic detection and upgrade support for each, and skills can be promoted from per-project to global scope. However, there is no explicit walkthrough of choosing scope at setup time, nor confirmation that the vendored/local files are meant to be committed with the repo. Missing for 10: explicit setup/config instructions for selecting project-local vs global scope, and confirmation that project-local files are intended to be committed to the repo.
